pictures.scene: Abraham van Beijeren, Still Life with Fish - the dead fish heaped up in the wicker basket in the dark kitchen, the long silver ones laid across one another with their mouths open and their eyes gone dull, the cut side of the salmon turned out red and raw beside them, the mussels spilled down on the bare table with the knife and the green cloth, the whole back of the room sunk in brown shadow, he sent darkness and it became dark yet they defied His words, he turned their waters to blood and caused their fish to die, their land teemed with frogs even in their royal chambers
pictures.name: pd_beijeren_stilleven_met_vissen

pictures.scene: Francisque Millet, Mountain Landscape with Lightning - the single bolt coming straight down the middle of the picture out of the black cloud with the gold light breaking behind it, the rain hanging in a grey curtain over the valley and the far snow mountains lit along the top, the little walled town and the arch of the bridge down in the dark below, the woman on the bank at the bottom throwing her arm up at the sky and the man in blue sitting beside her, he spoke and insects swarmed gnats throughout their country, he gave them hail for rain with lightning throughout their land, he struck their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country
pictures.name: pd_millet_berglandschap_met_bliksem

pictures.scene: Hans Andersen Brendekilde, Worn Out - the huge bare field of brown earth and loose flints running back empty to the horizon under a flat grey sky, the old labourer fallen flat on his back in the dirt with his arm thrown out and his cap knocked off beside his hand, the woman down on her knees over him in the red sleeves and the sack coloured shawl with her head turned away and her mouth open crying out for help, he spoke and the locusts came young locusts without number, they devoured every plant in their land and consumed the produce of their soil, then He struck all the firstborn in their land the firstfruits of all their vigor
pictures.name: pd_brendekilde_uitgeput

pictures.scene: Eero Jarnefelt, Sunset - the long bars of pink and violet and scarlet cloud laid right across the sky with the yellow fire burning low along the horizon and the rays of light slanting down out of it, the dark blue ridge of the far shore standing under them and the thin strip of still lake lying below that, the black green bushes and the rough grass of the near bank at the bottom, he brought Israel out with silver and gold and none among His tribes stumbled, Egypt was glad when they departed for the dread of Israel had fallen on them, he spread a cloud as a covering and a fire to light up the night
pictures.name: pd_jarnefelt_zonsondergang

pictures.scene: Johann Georg Meyer von Bremen, Turtle Doves - the big stoneware water jug standing up on the block of the stone well head with the small fair haired boy leaning in from the left to hold it by the handle, the girl in the red cap and the black laced bodice bending over from the right with her hand laid flat on the stone beside the painted dish of grain she has set out, the three doves come up on the board below in the shade of the vine, they asked and He brought quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven, he opened a rock and water gushed out it flowed like a river in the desert, for He remembered His holy promise to Abraham His servant
pictures.name: pd_bremen_tortelduifjes

pictures.scene: Hjalmar Munsterhjelm, Crack Willows - the two great willows standing over the bend of the sandy country road with their light green heads full of sun and the blue summer sky showing through the branches, the boy in the cap leaning back against the near trunk and the girl in the red kerchief sitting down in the grass at his feet with her basket beside her, the wide hayfield running away flat behind them to the far line of woods, he brought forth His people with rejoicing His chosen with shouts of joy, he gave them the lands of the nations that they might inherit the fruit of others labor, that they might keep His statutes and obey His laws hallelujah
pictures.name: pd_munsterhjelm_knotwilgen

lines.text: He sent darkness, and it became dark—
yet they defied His words.
He turned their waters to blood
and caused their fish to die.
Their land teemed with frogs,
even in their royal chambers.
He spoke, and insects swarmed—
gnats throughout their country.
He gave them hail for rain,
with lightning throughout their land.
He struck their vines and fig trees
and shattered the trees of their country.
He spoke, and the locusts came—
young locusts without number.
They devoured every plant in their land
and consumed the produce of their soil.
Then He struck all the firstborn in their land,
the firstfruits of all their vigor.
He brought Israel out with silver and gold,
and none among His tribes stumbled.
Egypt was glad when they departed,
for the dread of Israel had fallen on them.
He spread a cloud as a covering
and a fire to light up the night.
They asked, and He brought quail
and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
He opened a rock, and water gushed out;
it flowed like a river in the desert.
For He remembered His holy promise
to Abraham His servant.
He brought forth His people with rejoicing,
His chosen with shouts of joy.
He gave them the lands of the nations,
that they might inherit the fruit of others’ labor,
that they might keep His statutes
and obey His laws.
Hallelujah!
